rokto-joba.title: Rokto Joba
rokto-joba.story: Call it hibiscus or China rose or plain joba, the flower will always be her first favourite. Although a part of everyday arrangements, there was something exquisite about it. Her mother called it the jewel of her garden. But she knew it as the year-round spring of joy. You know how children are inducted into family rituals? She too was. Every Thursday, before leaving for school, she stepped out into the front garden with a cosy wicker basket in tow. She had to pick fresh hibiscus flowers, the bright red ones. Along with tagar or the pinwheel flower and a few strands of Durva grass. Who knew that such weekly meets would kindle a long-lasting relationship?!
rokto-joba.description: Sutas ˜made in heaven mul cotton, is also known as mul mul in West Bengal. The fabric is buttery soft and has a delicate beauty. Its weave is very fine and this lends a very fluid texture to the fabric, which makes draping it a breeze. It truly is like a hug that wraps you in its love.

hara-jalebi-green-viscose-kurta-pant-set.title: Hara Jalebi
hara-jalebi-green-viscose-kurta-pant-set.story: Hara Jalebi was always the calm one in the Jalebi gang. She liked her bottle-green kurta, her little gold flowers and, most importantly, her pockets. But calm never meant boring. One day, she paired herself with a pair of purple pants and suddenly found herself looking rather fabulous. “A little colour never hurt anyone,” she said, slipping her essentials into her pockets and heading out. She can spend the morning running errands, show up at a festive gathering by evening, and still look like she planned the whole thing. Hara Jalebi doesn’t make a fuss. She simply adds a little twist wherever she goes.
hara-jalebi-green-viscose-kurta-pant-set.description: Meet Hara Jalebi, a bottle-green kurta set that likes to keep things interesting. The sleeveless V-neck kurta comes with delicate gold zari floral embroidery tracing the neckline and pocket line, while straight-fit purple pants bring in a playful pop of contrast. Made in soft, easy-to-wear viscose and finished with pockets, Hara Jalebi is equal parts comfortable, colourful and ready for wherever the day takes her.

neelam-varq-saree.title: Neelam Varq
neelam-varq-saree.blousePiece: Yes (80 cm additional fabric for the blouse)
neelam-varq-saree.story:
Neelam Varq has always preferred the company of moonlight. She arrives in a deep, ink-blue, carrying a golden jaal that seems to have borrowed its sparkle from the stars. Her gold foil catches the light with every little movement, while the gold samosa lace along her edges gives her a touch of old-world grandeur. Her dark blue tassels trail behind, quietly adding to the drama.
But Neelam Varq isn't all mystery and magnificence. She is soft, breezy and wonderfully easygoing at heart. Made in airy mul cotton, she can spend the whole day wrapped around you and still be ready when the evening lights come on.
neelam-varq-saree.description:
Neelam Varq is a deep dark blue mul cotton saree that brings together timeless elegance and festive shimmer. Its rich ink-blue base features an intricate jaal design, finished with shimmering gold foil printing that catches the light beautifully.
Gold samosa lace detailing adds a classic festive touch, while dark blue tassels complete the look with a subtle, playful finish. Soft, lightweight and breathable, Neelam Varq is perfect for comfortable daytime celebrations and elegant festive evenings.

laali-chandrama-pink-tissue-tussar-silk-.title: Laali Chandrama
laali-chandrama-pink-tissue-tussar-silk-.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 7 days
laali-chandrama-pink-tissue-tussar-silk-.story:
Laali Chandrama has a soft spot for pink skies. She likes the kind that appear just before the sun goes down, when the world turns a little rosy and the evening feels like it’s about to become something special. So she decided to keep a little of that colour for herself.
Now she arrives in pink, with zari lines that glimmer as she moves, a plain zari pallu that catches the light and tassels that refuse to sit still. She’s sweet, she’s festive, and she knows exactly when to make an entrance. Her favourite part? When someone looks at her and says, “You look like a whole mood.”
laali-chandrama-pink-tissue-tussar-silk-.description: Soft, rosy and made for festive evenings, Laali Chandrama is a pink saree with delicate zari lines, a plain zari pallu and playful tassels. Paired with a blouse piece, its gentle shimmer and easy drape make it perfect for festive gatherings, dinner plans and nights that call for a little extra glow.

teen-patti.title: Teen Patti
teen-patti.description: Stand out with Teen Patti , a red woven mul cotton saree that balances tradition with vibrant twists. It features a colorblock layout and subtle zari border detailing. The olive green and pink jhalar tassels add a playful touch, making this a beautiful choice for celebratory occasions.

saawan.title: Saawan
saawan.story:
She always arrived with the rain.
Not the loud kind that rushed through the streets, but the gentle drizzle that made people pause by their windows. She loved the hush that came before the first drop, the smell of wet earth, and the way the whole world seemed to slow down for a while.
As she walked, tiny silver raindrops settled on her, refusing to leave. They sparkled with every step, as if the rain wanted to stay close a little longer.
That's why they called her Saawan .
saawan.description: Like rain meeting still waters, Saawan is calm, refreshing, and quietly enchanting. Crafted from Suta's signature feather-soft mul cotton in a soothing teal, this borderless saree is sprinkled with delicate silver sequins that shimmer like raindrops caught in the light. Light, breathable, and effortlessly graceful, it's made for days when you want to carry the magic of the monsoon wherever you go.

aamras-jalebi-yellow-viscose-kurta-pant-.title: Aamras Jalebi
aamras-jalebi-yellow-viscose-kurta-pant-.story: Meet Aamras Jalebi, a mustard-yellow kurta set with a little sunshine and a lot of charm. The V-neck kurta comes with breezy bell sleeves, pockets on both sides and delicate gold zari floral embroidery tracing the neckline and pocket line. Paired with deep-blue salwar pants, this viscose set brings together rich colours, soft comfort and just enough festive sparkle to make an entrance.
aamras-jalebi-yellow-viscose-kurta-pant-.description: Aamras Jalebi liked to take her time. She’d sway into a room in her mustard-yellow kurta, her bell sleeves following along like they had somewhere fun to be. Her dark-blue salwar pants kept things grounded, while little gold flowers quietly showed off around her neckline. And her pockets? Those were non-negotiable. She filled them with tiny treasures and went wherever the day called her. A festive lunch, a family gathering, an evening out for chai — Aamras Jalebi was ready. After all, she believed every good day deserved a little colour and a little twirl.

zafrani-varq-saree.title: Zafrani Varq
zafrani-varq-saree.blousePiece: Yes (80 cm additional fabric for the blouse)
zafrani-varq-saree.story: Zafrani Varq likes her mornings sunny, her evenings glowing and her festive days just a little golden. She arrives in a soft beige, covered in a delicate golden jaal that looks as though someone sprinkled a little saffron sunshine all over her. The gold foil catches the light with every move, while her gold samosa lace makes sure she never goes unnoticed. Her beige tassels? They simply bounce along, pretending they aren't enjoying all the attention.
zafrani-varq-saree.description:
Zafrani Varq is a soft beige mul cotton saree with a warm, festive personality. Its subtle beige base features an intricate jaal design, finished with shimmering gold foil printing for an elegant touch of festive sparkle.
Gold samosa lace detailing adds a classic finish along the edges, while beige tassels complete the look with understated charm. Lightweight, breathable and comfortable, Zafrani Varq is perfect for easy daytime celebrations and softly lit festive evenings alike.

firozi-varq-saree.title: Firozi Varq
firozi-varq-saree.blousePiece: Yes (80 cm additional fabric for the blouse)
firozi-varq-saree.story:
Firozi Varq has a soft spot for festive evenings and a rather serious love for gold. She arrives in a beautiful shaola teal, carrying a delicate golden jaal that seems to shimmer whenever she moves. Her gold foil catches the light, her samosa lace sits proudly along the edges, and her dark blue tassels trail behind like little midnight-blue secrets.
She looks like she belongs at a grand celebration, but don't be fooled by her fancy ways. Firozi Varq is made of soft, airy mul cotton and is happiest when she can twirl, wander and stay comfortable all day long. A little jewel-toned, a little dreamy, and always ready to sparkle, Firozi Varq knows how to make festive dressing feel effortless.
firozi-varq-saree.description:
Firozi Varq is a rich teal mul cotton saree designed for effortless festive dressing. Its shaola teal base features an intricate jaal design, brought to life with shimmering gold foil printing that catches the light beautifully.
Gold samosa lace detailing adds a traditional festive touch, while dark blue tassels bring depth and a playful finish. Soft, breathable and lightweight, Firozi Varq is perfect for everything from daytime festivities to elegant evenings.

surkh.title: Surkh
surkh.story:
She was born where flowers met fire.
The blossoms worried she'd be too bold. The flames worried she'd be too soft.
So she chose to become both.
She wrapped herself in the deepest shade of red and invited black flowers to bloom along her edges, not to tame the fire, but to dance beside it.
That's how she became Surkh .
She walks with the warmth of a glowing sunset and the grace of flowers swaying in the evening breeze. Fierce when she needs to be, gentle when it matters most, she reminds you that strength and softness have always belonged together.
surkh.description: Bold yet beautifully balanced, Surkh is a celebration of contrasts. Crafted from Suta's signature feather-soft mul cotton in a striking shade of red, this saree is adorned with intricate black floral embroidery that blooms gracefully along the border. The rich colours, delicate craftsmanship, and airy drape come together to create a saree that feels both powerful and effortless, made for days when you want your presence to linger long after you've left the room.

nitai.title: Nitai
nitai.description: An off-white woven mul cotton saree, framed with a red and gold zari border, and finished with an embroidered alpona design gracing the pallu. This is the quintessential Durga Puja look. Light, breathable, and festive-ready. It’s perfect for Ashtami Anjali or pandal-hopping from morning to night. Wear it once, and get ready for the inevitable question: “Where did you get this from?”

shonkho-sindoor-cotton-saree.title: Shonkho Sindoor
shonkho-sindoor-cotton-saree.blousePiece: Yes (60 cm additional fabric with the saree)
shonkho-sindoor-cotton-saree.story:
Shonkho Sindoor has two things on her mind: shonkho and sindoor. She begins in pristine white, like the first conch shell blowing through the Pujo morning. Then comes the sindoor-red maroon pallu, because every beautiful Pujo story needs a little colour.
Her golden Durga eyes watch everything, the anjali, the dhaak, the laughter, the endless adda. The gold dainty lace adds a little sparkle, while her maroon tassels happily swing along. She’s a little bit of prayer, a little bit celebration, and completely Pujo.
shonkho-sindoor-cotton-saree.description: A little bit of Pujo drama, a little bit of divine detail, Shonkho Sindoor brings crisp white cotton together with golden foil-printed Durga eyes, a contrasting maroon pallu, playful foil polka dots, and a delicate gold dainty lace. Finished with maroon tassels that sway with every step, she’s festive, easy and full of personality. Made for anjali, pandal hopping, and evenings that turn into adda without warning.

pujo-pujo-gondho-saree.title: Pujo Pujo Gondho
pujo-pujo-gondho-saree.description: Pujo Pujo Gondho is crafted from mul modal fabric in traditional red and maroon hues. This saree captures the essence of autumn, blending the fragrance of Shiuli flowers with the aroma of clay idols from Kumortuli and the sight of Kash phool all around. Featuring ombre hand-dye with red on top and maroon on the bottom, this saree has beautiful foil printing on the border that reads "pujo pujo gondho." The handmade crochet flowers, hand-stitched all over the body, are the highlight of the saree. The elegant gold lace along the border and the floral butta throughout the body add an extra layer of charm. Drape yourself in the Pujo Pujo Gondho saree this Durga Puja.

gopal.title: Gopal
gopal.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 3 days
gopal.description: Designed with Pujo days in mind, this maroon cotton blouse with a refined dome neckline and sleeveless cut is all about keeping you chic and comfortable. The breathable cotton keeps you cool when the pandal crowds get overwhelming. It’s the kind of blouse that lets you move, laugh, eat, dance, and join the adda without a second thought. Pair it with your favourite saree and you’re set for long, joy-filled Pujo days—no fuss, just full carefree abandon.

thankam.title: Thankam
thankam.story: One afternoon, while waiting for the bus, she struck up a conversation with an elderly woman. It began innocuously enough, with a simple enquiry, but they soon found themselves laughing and chatting all the way home. Soon, the conversations became a part of her daily routine and she looked forward to this unlikely friendship. They talked about their families, their hopes, dreams, goals and everything under the sun. She looked forward to telling her new friend how her day had been, saving up little experiences to share on the bus journey. It wasnt a friendship that many would understand; but to them, it was a bond that was more precious than the rarest gold.
thankam.description: One of the most popular natural fibres in the world, cotton is hailed for its beauty, comfort, durability and versatility. Cotton is also naturally sustainable and its cultivation supports local farmers and communities. A low maintenance fabric, cotton is also hypoallergenic, making it the perfect choice around the year. The addition of zari adds a delicate but regal sheen, which makes these garments ideal for casual or occasion-wear.

pontharam.title: Pontharam
pontharam.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 3 Days.
pontharam.description: Pontharam means a big, bright star, and this blouse carries that kind of brilliance. Woven in handloom Chanderi silk with zari, it glows with metallicō gold. Feels like stardust on skin. The V-neckline draws the gaze upward and creates a silhouette that feels taller, sleeker, more poised. Lightly puffed sleeves soften the sharpness and add a sculptural curve to the shoulders. Handcrafted for festivities, for women who walk in like constellations. You will radiate in it and eclipse everything else.

kanakam.title: Kanakam
kanakam.story: One morning, as she was tending to her plants, she noticed that a few leaves bore butterfly eggs. Excited to witness the fabled transformation herself, she spent the next few days observing the eggs. They hatched into little caterpillars with the most voracious appetites. The little bugs grew bigger every day, until one day, they spun a gnarly cocoon to harbour in. She knew that that was where the magic would unfold “ the process of chrysalis that would transform these shapeless rotund beings into things of beauty. Her patience was rewarded when the cocoons cracked upon to reveal the most stunning butterflies she had ever seen.
kanakam.description: Chanderi is a luxurious fabric that is oh-so-light while also possessing a rich exuberance. It is a culmination of silk, cotton and zari woven together on the warp and weft in various combinations to attain different textures. The resultant fabric instantly captures the heart and really brings out the colours that are woven. It is no wonder that this fabric has been one of the most popular ones since ancient times in our country and has been embraced by royalty with open arms. The grandeur that Chanderi brings while remaining so elegant is a beautiful combination and perfect for festivities!

haldi-hustle.title: Haldi Hustle
haldi-hustle.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 10 days
haldi-hustle.description: Crafted in breathable woven mul cotton, Haldi Hustle is a sunshine-ready saree in a charming yellow and purple colour. The bold colorblock design is elevated with a gleaming zari border and finished with purple jhalar tassels for a festive edge. Lightweight, easy to drape, and perfect for haldi or daytime celebrations.

hara-jamun.title: Hara jamun
hara-jamun.description: With a unique blue and olive green color combination, Hara Jamun is a fresh twist on festive dressing. The soft woven mul cotton keeps it easy to wear, while the zari border and matching olive green tassels offer a rich finish. Perfect for statement daywear.

kesar-ink.title: Kesar Ink
kesar-ink.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 10 days
kesar-ink.description: Bold purple meets lively green in Kesar Ink , a woven mul cotton saree with a refreshing colorblock composition. Finished with green jhalar tassels and a glinting zari border, this saree is perfect for those who love a rich, jewel-toned look with a playful twist.

kedar-ki-dor-blouse.title: Kedar Ki Dor
kedar-ki-dor-blouse.story:
She is the sun, she is the moon, she is the shooting star that grants the boon.
She has the whole galaxy in her eyes, she is the rare night, the one with fireflies.
She is a paradise, that no one ever found, she captures the universe, and infinities beyond.
She is a goddess, and she is a human, she bounces back stronger, she is that invincible woman.
This gorgeous silk blouse, in pink, is the perfect amalgamation of comfort and beauty that fits like a dream.
kedar-ki-dor-blouse.description:
Silk exudes a grandeur that very few other fabrics can. It is versatile and can boast of a grand appeal as well as a quiet grace. It is comfort and regality coming together. This is a fabric that can never go wrong! So, whether you are all set for a night of glamour or you want to make a subtle statement, the lustrous fabric of silk can be just the thing you are looking for!
You Asked, We Delivered! This blouse is now available in 3XL and 4XL!

dipped-in-green.title: Dipped In Green
dipped-in-green.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 15 days.
dipped-in-green.description: Comfortable green cotton stretchable blouse is all you need in your wardrobe. Dipped in Green is your go-to green blouse with a secure elastic fit. Featuring classic U-neck styling and a front hook opening, it’s tailored for everyday seamless OOTD. Tailored in half sleeves for your comfort and style.

swarna-kamal.title: Swarna Kamal
swarna-kamal.story: It was the first time shed decided to do something for herself. She decided to sign up for a yoga class, not knowing what to expect but only that she wanted to feel healthier from within. There, surrounded by men and women shed never met before, she followed the teachers instructions to enter the lotus position “ her legs were crossed, her hips open and her fingers interlocked in her lap. And then, she closed her eyes and meditated. Her mind drifted to her struggles shed overcome to get this far. Each challenge had made her stronger. Each battle made her more resolute. For she was the golden lotus, and she would always rise above every odd.
swarna-kamal.description: Silk is naturally obtained from the cocoons of the silk moth Bombyx mori. Silk fibres obtained from the cocoon are wound on spools and woven on looms. The history of silk production dates back to ancient China, where silk was first discovered. Gradually, the production and trade of silk spread to different parts of the world, via the silk route. This lustrous fabric is said to be one of the strongest natural fabrics in the world and is known for its high textile strength.

hara-basic-blouse.title: Hara Basic
hara-basic-blouse.collection: Made In India Blouse and Basic Blouses
hara-basic-blouse.story: She was engulfed by the pristine embrace of the canopy. Away from the concrete jungles, she could hear her heartbeat again. And there was a mysterious sync between her own pulse and the rest of the world. As she shed layer after layer, she found herself while she got lost in the green!
hara-basic-blouse.description:
Silk exudes a regality that very few other fabrics can match. The brilliant shine that vibrates from a silk saree spells class and traditional beauty. India is one of the top producers of silk in the world and the fabric is always in demand for its visual attractiveness. People associate silk with special occasions and richness. Silk is alluring and can boast of a grand appeal as well as a tinge of nostalgia. On the whole, silk is a fabric that can never go wrong. This artificial silk fabric is made with synthetic fibres that look and feel like silk while making the luxurious experience of silk affordable to all.
You Asked, We Delivered! This blouse is now available in 3XL and 4XL!

pura-chandrama-olive-green-tissue-tussar.title: Pura Chandrama
pura-chandrama-olive-green-tissue-tussar.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 7 days
pura-chandrama-olive-green-tissue-tussar.story:
Pura Chandrama doesn’t do half-hearted appearances. When she shows up, she shows up fully, much like the moon on her favourite night of the month. Dressed in olive green, with zari lines glinting every time she moves, she has no interest in hiding behind clouds.
Her plain zari pallu brings the glow, her tassels bring the fun, and she brings the kind of energy that says, “Yes, I dressed up. And?” Full moon. Full plans. Full festive mood. Pura Chandrama wouldn’t have it any other way.
pura-chandrama-olive-green-tissue-tussar.description: Soft, luminous and ready for a night of festivities, Pura Chandrama is an olive green saree detailed with delicate zari lines, a plain zari pallu and playful tassels. Complete with a blouse piece, its easy drape and subtle shimmer make it a lovely pick for festive dinners, celebrations and evenings under the moon.

saanjh-chandrama-dark-blue-tissue-tussar.title: Saanjh Chandrama
saanjh-chandrama-dark-blue-tissue-tussar.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 7 days
saanjh-chandrama-dark-blue-tissue-tussar.story:
Saanjh Chandrama is that little pause between day and night. She arrives just as the sky turns deep blue, when the last bit of sunlight is still hanging around and the evening is deciding what it wants to become.
Her zari lines catch whatever light is left, her plain zari pallu follows along gracefully, and her tassels? They’re already ready for the evening plans. She loves festive dinners, rooftop conversations and celebrations that begin at sunset and somehow continue well past it. If dusk had a favourite saree, we think it would be her.
saanjh-chandrama-dark-blue-tissue-tussar.description: Inspired by the magic of dusk, Saanjh Chandrama is a soft dark blue saree with delicate zari lines, a plain zari pallu and playful tassels. Paired with a blouse piece, it brings a subtle shimmer to the drape while keeping things soft and easy. Made for festive evenings, intimate celebrations and nights that begin at sunset.

ratri-chandrama-black-tissue-tussar-silk.title: Ratri Chandrama
ratri-chandrama-black-tissue-tussar-silk.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 7 days
ratri-chandrama-black-tissue-tussar-silk.story:
Ratri Chandrama only comes out after sunset. She waits for the lights to dim, the music to start and everyone to be ready for a little night-time mischief. Then she arrives in black, with zari lines catching the light like tiny stars, her plain zari pallu trailing behind and her tassels quietly having the time of their life.
She likes festive nights, late dinners and plans that begin with “just one drink” and somehow end much later. She doesn’t need the moon to shine on her. She’s got her own glow.
ratri-chandrama-black-tissue-tussar-silk.description: Dark, dreamy and made for the night, Ratri Chandrama is a soft black saree with delicate zari lines, a plain zari pallu and playful tassels. Paired with a blouse piece, it brings together the ease of a soft drape with just the right touch of shimmer for festive evenings and after-dark celebrations.

glow-alat-palat.title: Glow Alat Palat
glow-alat-palat.description:
Some days, you feel like one version of yourself. Some days, you don’t. Alat Palat is made for all of it, the in-betweens, the switches, the sudden changes of heart. A collection of blouses that don’t ask you to choose, because they already know you won’t stay the same for too long.
Each piece is reversible, two sides, two moods, two little stories stitched into one. A burst of colour or a moment of calm. A shimmer or a softness. A print that speaks or a texture that simply stays.

tulasi.title: Tulasi
tulasi.story:
In the heart of a mystical garden, the tulsi plant stood alone, captivating all who ventured near. Its emerald leaves shimmered with an otherworldly glow, as if whispering ancient secrets of forgotten realms. When the moon adorned the night sky, the tulsi seemed to dance with the stars, creating a celestial spectacle.
Legends spoke of its healing powers, believed to ward off negativity and grant blessings to those who embraced its essence. Its fragrance, a divine elixir, carried the promise of spiritual awakening. Some said that on quiet nights, the tulsi whispered prayers to the universe, bridging the gap between mortals and ethereal beings.
tulasi.description:
Art silk is composed of synthetic fibres and mimics real silk in terms of its texture and appearance. It is lightweight, easy to wear and has a beautiful lustre. This art silk blouse is embellished with zari detailing, which gives the blouse an even more luxurious feel.
You Asked, We Delivered! This blouse is now available in 3XL and 4XL!

aambal.title: Aambal
aambal.story:
The pink lily blossomed in the nights darkest depths, a beacon of innocence and purity. Its tender petals, like delicate silk, cradled morning dew as if cherishing each droplet of life.
In the quiet moments of dawn, it unveiled a world untouched by cynicism, reminding all who gazed upon its beauty of the untouched innocence within themselves. The pink lily's allure held a certain vulnerability; yet in that fragility, it emanated strength. It was a symbol of grace, an emblem of hope, a precious reminder of the beauty that resides in the simplest and purest moments of life.
Let the precious pink and gold of this blouse harken back to the beauty of lifes simpler joys.
aambal.description:
Art silk is composed of synthetic fibres and mimics real silk in terms of its texture and appearance. It is lightweight, easy to wear and has a beautiful lustre. This art silk blouse is embellished with zari detailing, which gives the blouse an even more luxurious feel.
Note - This blouse has small slits on the sides designed for extended comfort and ease of movement

jal-kamal.title: Jal Kamal
jal-kamal.story: Rumour was that the lake was as old as time itself. It held many secrets in its depths. It had seen many, like her, visit its banks and gaze at it with a combination of awe and bewilderment. Some believed that an ancient monster lurked deep within it. Some others claimed that the lake was as barren as a desert as it had been cursed thousands of years ago. But it wasnt the lakes reputation that drew her to it. The lake reminded her that no matter how much the world changed, some things would remain as custodians of history. They would be the link between the present, past and future. And to be in its presence was a truly special experience.
jal-kamal.description: Silk is naturally obtained from the cocoons of the silk moth Bombyx mori. Silk fibres obtained from the cocoon are wound on spools and woven on looms. The history of silk production dates back to ancient China, where silk was first discovered. Gradually, the production and trade of silk spread to different parts of the world, via the silk route. This lustrous fabric is said to be one of the strongest natural fabrics in the world and is known for its high textile strength.

rangooni-jalebi-pink-viscose-kurta-pant-.title: Rangooni Jalebi
rangooni-jalebi-pink-viscose-kurta-pant-.story: Rangooni Jalebi had one rule: never arrive quietly. So she picked the brightest pink she could find, invited an orange pair of pants along for company, and sprinkled a little gold around her neckline for good measure. She was particularly proud of her pockets. “A girl needs somewhere to keep her secrets,” she said, before slipping in lipstick and heading out. Some days, you’ll find her at a festive celebration, looking every bit the part. Other days, she’ll be out for chai, perfectly happy being the most colourful person at the table. Rangooni Jalebi likes it that way. A little festive, a little everyday, and always ready for a twist.
rangooni-jalebi-pink-viscose-kurta-pant-.description: Meet Rangooni Jalebi, a hot-pink kurta set with a little golden mischief and a very bright orange sidekick. The sleeveless V-neck kurta comes with delicate gold zari floral embroidery along the neckline and pocket line, plus handy pockets for all the little things. Paired with pop-orange straight-fit pants, this set brings together colour, comfort and just the right amount of festive sparkle. Made in soft, easy-to-wear viscose, it’s happy at celebrations, coffee dates and everywhere in between.

rani-jalebi-black-viscose-kurta-pant-set.title: Rani Jalebi
rani-jalebi-black-viscose-kurta-pant-set.story: Meet Rani Jalebi, a striking black kurta set with a dark-orange twist. The V-neck kurta comes with breezy bell sleeves, pockets on both sides and delicate gold zari floral embroidery along the neckline and pocket line. Paired with dark-orange salwar pants and made in soft, comfortable viscose, this set knows how to bring a little drama to festive dressing while staying wonderfully easy to wear.
rani-jalebi-black-viscose-kurta-pant-set.description: Rani Jalebi never entered a room quietly. She arrived in black, brought a little dark orange along for company, and let tiny gold flowers do the talking. Her bell sleeves swayed as she walked, her pockets held all her little secrets, and her salwar pants followed along like they knew exactly where the evening was headed. She could be found at a festive gathering, an impromptu dinner or simply out for chai looking far more dressed up than she intended. Rani Jalebi liked a little drama, but never at the expense of comfort. That was simply not her style.

raktim-varq-saree.title: Raktim Varq
raktim-varq-saree.blousePiece: Yes (80 cm additional fabric for the blouse)
raktim-varq-saree.story: Raktim Varq has never been one for quiet celebrations. She arrives in deep maroon, looking like she has just stepped out of a very grand festive evening. Her golden jaal catches the light as she moves, while the gold foil makes sure she leaves a little sparkle wherever she goes. Along her edges sits her favourite gold samosa lace, looking rather pleased with itself. And her maroon tassels? They sway along merrily, adding their own little bit of drama.
raktim-varq-saree.description:
Raktim Varq is a rich maroon mul cotton saree designed for effortless festive glamour. Its deep maroon base features an intricate jaal design, enhanced with shimmering gold foil printing that adds a beautiful festive glow.
Gold samosa lace detailing lends a traditional touch to the edges, while matching maroon tassels add a playful finish. Soft, breathable and lightweight, Raktim Varq is comfortable enough for long festive days and striking enough for evening celebrations.

reth-ki-lakeer-blouse.title: Reth Ki Lakeer
reth-ki-lakeer-blouse.story: She had beautiful bronze skin and glittering sand eyes. Society sneered and sniggered at her gumption. Yet, smiling radiantly into the ailing worlds she went. She made medicines, potions, and herbal concoctions treating the ones holding on to fraying faith. For the golden sand eyes, a reflection of her heart, believed in the magic of generosity to cure bigoted prejudice in the world.
reth-ki-lakeer-blouse.description: The blouses in this collection are a coming together of comfort, sparkle and style! The base fabric is artificial silk and we have brought in an array of different embellishments that create a stunning effect on the blouse! The work on blouses is partially hand-embroidered and the detailing adds extra charm too. So, let the spotlight take you in its engulf with these bold and gorgeous, versatile blouses right away!

kashi-sa-mann-blouse.title: Kashi Sa Mann
kashi-sa-mann-blouse.story:
She has the whole galaxy in her eyes, she is the rare night, the one with fireflies.
She is a paradise, that no one ever found, she captures the universe, and infinities beyond.
She is a goddess, and she is a human, she bounces back stronger, she is that invincible woman.
This gorgeous silk blouse, in pink, is the perfect amalgamation of comfort and beauty that fits like a dream.
kashi-sa-mann-blouse.description: Silk exudes a grandeur that very few other fabrics can. It is versatile and can boast of a grand appeal as well as a quiet grace. It is comfort and regality coming together. This is a fabric that can never go wrong! So, whether you are all set for a night of glamour or you want to make a subtle statement, the lustrous fabric of silk can be just the thing you are looking for!

meri-chaandi.title: Meri Chaandi
meri-chaandi.preOrder: This is a pre-order and your order will be shipped within 7 days
meri-chaandi.description: A golden glow that never fades, Meri Chaandi is the very definition of festive glamour. Crafted in luminous gold linen, this blouse dazzles with intricate sequin embroidery and a flattering V neckline. The delicate cap sleeves add a hint of vintage grace, while the shimmer makes it perfect for wedding nights, sangeet lights, or any moment that calls for celebration. It’s a blouse made to make memories shine.

safeed-ishq.title: Safeed Ishq
safeed-ishq.story:
She fell in love with everything.
The first sip of chai in the morning. Rain tapping against the window. Books with folded corners. People who laughed with their whole heart.
Every time something made her smile, a tiny red heart appeared on her.
One became two. Two became twenty.
Soon, she was covered in little reminders that love isn't rare at all. It's everywhere, if you remember to notice it.
That's how she became Safed Ishq .
Soft as a blank page, carrying tiny embroidered hearts like secrets only the observant can find. She doesn't believe love needs a reason. She simply believes there's always room for one more little heart.
safeed-ishq.description: Love doesn't always arrive with grand gestures. Sometimes, it lingers in little moments, a shared smile, a handwritten note, or a heart doodled in the corner of a page. Safed Ishq celebrates exactly that. Crafted from Suta's signature feather-soft mul cotton in a serene white, this borderless saree is scattered with tiny embroidered red hearts, adding a playful touch to an otherwise understated drape. Light, breathable, and full of charm, it's a saree that wears its heart with quiet confidence.

neela-aasmaan.title: Neela Aasmaan
neela-aasmaan.story:
She belonged to the sky.
Not because she could fly, but because she carried the same quiet vastness wherever she went. She never hurried. She drifted through the day like passing clouds, making room for dreams, long conversations, and moments that didn't need words.
The clouds loved her so much that they stitched little white scallops along her edges before letting her leave.
"Now you'll always carry a piece of us," they whispered.
And so she became Neela Aasmaan .
Soft as the sky after the rain, edged with little cloud-like waves, she reminds everyone who wraps themselves in her to look up once in a while. You never know what beautiful things are waiting above.
neela-aasmaan.description: There is something endlessly calming about looking up at an open sky. Neela Aasmaan captures that feeling in a drape. Crafted from Suta's signature feather-soft mul cotton in a soothing bluish-grey, this saree is finished with a delicate white scalloped crochet lace that gently frames its edges. Light, breathable, and effortlessly elegant, it's a saree that lets simplicity do all the talking, making it perfect for slow mornings, meaningful celebrations, and everything in between.

jashn-alat-palat.title: Jashn Alat Palat
jashn-alat-palat.story:
She loved every celebration.
The music, the lights, the laughter, the quiet moments before everyone arrived.
But every festival brought the same question.
"What should I wear today?"
She smiled, twirled once, and turned herself inside out.
One moment she was glowing in festive red, the next she stood wrapped in the richness of deep green.
The celebrations applauded.
That's how she became Jashn Alat Palat.
She believes every occasion deserves a little surprise, and every woman deserves more than one way to shine. So she changes with the moment, carrying two celebrations in one beautiful blouse.
jashn-alat-palat.description: A celebration deserves more than one look, and Jashn Alat Palat brings you exactly that. This reversible, stretchable padded blouse is crafted from rich viscose zari brocade with elegant elbow-length sleeves, giving you two festive looks in one. One side glows in a vibrant red adorned with gold motifs, while the other unfolds into a deep green, equally rich and striking. Comfortable, versatile, and thoughtfully designed, it's a blouse that lets you switch your mood, your saree pairing, and your style with just one flip.

hatke-alat-palat.title: Hatke Alat Palat
hatke-alat-palat.story:
Everyone expected her to choose the brighter path.
Instead, she fell in love with colours that whispered.
The warm earth after the rain. The quiet glow of morning light.
"That's a strange pair," people said.
She simply smiled and flipped.
One side carried the richness of brown, the other the calm of off-white. Together, they made perfect sense.
That's how she became Hatke Alat Palat.
She reminds you that the most beautiful combinations aren't always the obvious ones. Sometimes, they're the ones that quietly grow on you until you can't imagine them any other way.
hatke-alat-palat.description: Unexpected combinations often make the most memorable outfits, and Hatke Alat Palat is proof. This reversible, stretchable padded blouse is crafted in rich viscose zari brocade with elegant elbow-length sleeves, giving you two versatile looks in one. One side features a warm, earthy brown, while the other reveals a soft off-white, making it just as easy to style with festive drapes as it is with everyday favourites. Comfortable, flattering, and endlessly adaptable, it's made for those who love a little surprise in their wardrobe.

dilbar-alat-palat.title: Dilbar Alat Palat
dilbar-alat-palat.story:
She had two favourite songs.
One was full of sunshine, laughter, and long walks through green fields. The other belonged to quiet evenings, starry skies, and conversations that lasted long after midnight.
She loved them both too much to choose.
So she learnt a little trick.
With one playful flip, she became whoever the moment needed her to be.
That's how she became Dilbar Alat Palat.
One side carries the freshness of green, the other the quiet confidence of black. She never asks you to choose between bold and subtle, because she knows the heart always has room for both.
dilbar-alat-palat.description: Two timeless colours, endless styling possibilities. Dilbar Alat Palat is a reversible, stretchable padded blouse crafted in soft cotton with elegant elbow-length sleeves. One side comes alive in a refreshing green, while the other embraces the effortless charm of classic black, making it easy to pair with everything from vibrant prints to understated solids. Comfortable, breathable, and thoughtfully designed, it's a blouse you'll find yourself reaching for, no matter the occasion.
